in_hebrew.name: Andros
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Andros הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'andros' meaning 'man' or 'mankind'. In Christian tradition, the name Andros is associated with the androgynous figure of Jesus, who embodies both the masculine and feminine aspects of God.
